sourceEvidence.claim: Endotoxin block — LPS text (full physical order, lines 73-85)
sourceEvidence.quote:
Endotoxin

LPS found in outer membrane of gram ⊝
bacteria (both cocci and rods). Composed
of O-antigen + core polysaccharide + lipid
A (the toxic component). Neisseria have
lipooligosaccharide.
Released upon cell lysis or by living cells by
blebs detaching from outer surface membrane
(vs exotoxin, which is actively secreted).
Three main effects: macrophage activation
(TLR4/CD14), complement activation, and
tissue factor activation.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.

kypExtensions.summary: The mailed-protein vs shed-wall model of the axis (secretion, chemistry, genes, per-dose potency, vaccine-ability, heat); the amplification model (the cascade compensates endotoxin's low nominal toxicity); the spastic-vs-flaccid SNARE address split (cord vs junction); the superantigen-vs-AB-toxin precision distinction (cross-link outside the binding site vs B-binds/A-acts); and the three heat-stable exceptions as a memorized exception set — with the Jarisch-Herxheimer-like release concept, pharmaceutical pyrogen monitoring, and therapeutic botulinum use labeled as extensions.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the comparison and cascade without the delivery-design taxonomy or the address-split models; these integrations are KYP's design.
